title: His first band and the draft
summary: His first band included Copeland, Maurice Durand, Charlie Bernard and Joe Watson; he left for St. Louis and was drafted around 1916-17.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: What was your very first band then, after you started out?
Well, my first band was named, we had a fella by the name of Thomas Copeland, Maurice Duran.
What did Copeland play? I knew him.
He used to play bass, Thomas Copeland.
I knew Maurice Duran, he was a trumpet player.

Yeah, the clarinet player was named, he died, too. And the bass, the banjo player was named Bernard, Charlie Bernard. Yeah. I can't think of the clarinet player name, good as I know him, too. All of them is dead, all of them. Maurice was living there. Yeah, Maurice. He was down there when Ricard died.
Yeah. And he was in San Francisco, I guess, when he died there.
Yeah. Yeah, Joe Watson, the clarinet player. Oh, Joe Watson.
Joe Watson. Yeah, I've seen a picture of him.
I believe it was, maybe Camellia Band or some...
That's the band that Milly Bond had, Camellia Band. But before that, it wasn't a Camellia Band.
It wasn't, I don't remember a word, but...
Then I left, I went to San Luis, but I wasn't playing up there. And I got drafted on me up there, around 1916, 17.
